notes: MEBP follows the parts instead of the bar end. Shifting the parts down the bar with Adjust moved the cutting windows but not the measure cycle, which stayed parked 30mm in from the bar end and kept measuring material you had just decided not to use. The find pattern now positions itself on the span the parts occupy - only the starting position moves, the X spread between stations is unchanged because that spread is what fixes yaw. Conveyor jog buttons work again: they had been moved to the robot's own jog inputs and stopped responding, because the PLC writes those four inputs as ladder coils every scan so the write never survived. They are back on the PLC bits, the correct owner; tip change and home stay direct. Includes 3.9.8 for fresh installs - one J move per face, and the fix for silent updates re-branding X-Series installs as Kraftech.
